Simple purées

Pear purée

Körtepüré

6 months+ Sound idea 20 min 4 portions

Serve warm or cool, smooth enough for a spoon.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 320 g ripe pears (prepared weight, peeled and cored)
  • 2 tbsp water (for the pan)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Peel the pears and remove the cores.
  2. Cook in a small splash of water until soft, about 8 minutes.
  3. Blend until smooth.
  4. Cool until just warm.
  5. Do not add sugar.

Sound idea

The skin and core do not belong in a first purée, and sugar is unnecessary.

Peel the ripe pear, remove the core, cook, and blend. No other change is needed if salt and sugar stay out.
